decisions.name: go-api-contracts
decisions.reason: The task evolves exported library behavior, CSV and JSON file formats, error identity, and real CLI grammar/status/stream contracts while preserving Go1.22 and existing function types.

decisions.name: go-behavior-tests
decisions.reason: Meaningful implementation and high-quality regression tests are explicitly requested; observations include accepted prefixes, exact prior/new bytes, strict status and JSON boundaries, and independent callback/release failures.

decisions.name: go-core-style
decisions.reason: Production Go and Go tests are being written; use straightforward errors, guard clauses, standard-library types, formatting, vet and race checks without installing tools.

decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
decisions.reason: Refresh borrows a supplied HTTP client/context and owns acquired bodies; Serve owns callback completion and release; the command owns signals and client cleanup. Existing concrete clients/functions suffice.

decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
decisions.reason: CSV ingestion, HTTP refresh and lifecycle responsibilities are added to the library and wired by the existing command. Keeping the two existing packages is the smallest justified placement; no split or new interface is needed.

decisions.name: go-test-isolation
decisions.reason: Tests own temporary files, subprocesses, local HTTP servers, response bodies, cancellation gates, timers and goroutines; test selection, bounded joins, child-local file limits and explicit executable environments matter.

reference_decisions.reason: Choose retained-state observations for failures during writes, independent work/release error cases, and exact external oracles.
Choose Go1.22-compatible synchronization, early-failure cleanup, fixture fidelity, timing control and focused selection checks.
No package split or comparison of alternative project shapes was necessary.

scope: Only the standalone dispatch, its isolated module and offered relevant guidance were inspected. No repository design record, eval JSON, controller probe, or other author workspace was inspected.
